title: Two Screens, One Stage
hook_vo: One stage, two screens: the video for the audience, the words for the singers.

beats.vo: Open Stage output, and add a screen for the stage monitor.
Turn the background off there, and the singers get the words on black.
The on-air chip lists every screen, each with its own power switch.
Unplug a monitor, and it picks up again as soon as it's back.
